about.text: IMT Ghaziabad was established with the backing of the Government of India and under the auspices of the Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI). The institute is located in Ghaziabad, Uttar Pradesh. It has a spacious campus outfitted with cutting-edge infrastructure, contemporary classrooms, well-stocked libraries, and cutting-edge technology to give students an optimum learning environment.

about.text: The faculty of IMT Ghaziabad is diversified and experienced, consisting of prominent academicians and industry specialists. Faculty members are passionately devoted to providing high-quality education and actively participate in research and consulting initiatives. Their combination of academic and practical knowledge guarantees that students thoroughly understand business principles and their implementation in real-world circumstances.

IMT Ghaziabad maintains close relationships with industry leaders and actively seeks cooperation with reputable firms and organizations. The business Interface Cell of the institute is critical in organizing guest lectures, business visits, internships, and placement events, allowing students to get exposure to the corporate world. IMT Ghaziabad has a strong placement record, with students getting coveted positions in prominent national and international corporations across various industries.

facts: IMT Ghaziabad was founded in 1980 under the auspices of the Industrial Credit and Investment Corporation of India (ICICI) and with the assistance of the Government of India.
IMT Ghaziabad is accredited by the National Board of Accreditation (NBA) and the Association to Advance Collegiate Schools of Business(AACSB) as one of India's best business schools.
The faculty at IMT Ghaziabad comprises renowned academicians and industry leaders who offer a wealth of expertise and experience to the classroom.
IMT Ghaziabad has developed excellent relationships with top national and international corporations.

The institution works with industry partners to provide students with practical insights and exposure to real-world business settings through guest lectures, industrial visits, live projects, internships, and placement possibilities.
Through its Entrepreneurship Development Cell, IMT Ghaziabad encourages an entrepreneurial attitude among its students.
IMT Ghaziabad has a large and diverse alum network, with graduates occupying leadership positions in prestigious corporations worldwide.
IMT Ghaziabad is routinely ranked among India's best business schools. Leading journals such as Business Today, Business World, and Outlook have named it one of the top B-Schools.

The institute provides various management programs, including a two-year full-time Post Graduate Diploma in Management (PGDM) and speciality PGDM programs in Marketing, Finance, Human Resources, Operations, and Business Analytics.
NIRF 2025 placed IMT Ghaziabad 30th in the Management category.

emi.text: IMT Ghaziabad offers EMI to students for tuition payments. The institute recognizes students' financial limits and provides various payment choices to alleviate the stress of upfront payment. Because the particular specifics and terms of the EMI facility may differ, students should contact the institute's admissions or finance department for further information and detailed assistance on using this facility.

admission.text: Admission to IMT Ghaziabad's management programs normally entails the following steps:
Step 1: Applicants must verify that they satisfy the eligibility requirements established by IMT Ghaziabad for the program to which they desire to apply.

Step 2: Applicants must sit for a practical entrance exam. IMT Ghaziabad accepts CAT (Common Admission Test), XAT (Xavier Aptitude Test), GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test), and CMAT (Common Management Admission Test) results.
Step 3: Following the entrance exam, the applicant must fill up the online application form, which is available on the official IMT Ghaziabad admissions page.
Step 4: Shortlisted applicants will get an invitation to the next step of the selection process, which often involves a Personal Interview (PI) based on their admission exam scores.
Step 5: IMT Ghaziabad will thoroughly screen the applicant’s profile to identify those who exhibit academic achievement, leadership potential, and a well-rounded personality.
Step 6: Accepted candidates will receive an official offer letter from IMT Ghaziabad.
Step 7: To ensure their spot, selected candidates must confirm their acceptance by paying the program fee by the deadline.

faculty.name: Prof. Puja Aggarwal Gulati
faculty.title: Program Director | Assoc. Professor Finance
faculty.description: An expert in all things finance, Prof. Puja has years of experience in teaching with her core interests in IFRS and stocks.

faculty.name: Prof. Abhishek S
faculty.title: Associate Professor, IMT Ghaziabad
faculty.description: Prof. Abhishek has many years of experience working, researching, and teaching in the marketing domain. He has a conceptual and practical understanding of issues in marketing communication, consumer behavior, and retailing. During his work experience in the marketing domain, he has been exposed to different contexts ranging from rural consumers in far-flung markets to the influence of the latest technology in consumer purchase decisions. As an academic, his research interests have been in the field of marketing communications, e-commerce and digital marketing, promotion planning, and consumer behavior in retail context. His current research work looks at advertising issues with public policy implications and the role of technology in marketing communications. He is excited to learn and discover the opportunities offered by digital platforms with an increasing focus on mobile platforms and technology.

faculty.name: Prof. Harvinder Singh
faculty.title: Professor Marketing, IMT Ghaziabad
faculty.description: An expert in the business domain, Prof. Harvinder has been awarded “The Best Professor in Marketing Management” by the World Education Congress.

faculty.name: Dr. Richa
faculty.title: Asst. Professor, IMT Ghaziabad
faculty.description: As a Visiting / Adjunct faculty, she has taught courses in some of the leading Business schools of the country including IIM Kozhikode, IIM Indore, IIM Ranchi, and IIM Amritsar. She is actively engaged in Executive Education and has delivered for some of the leading clients across the sectors. She is also professionally certified in administering Psychometric instruments like MBTI and FIRO-B. She has also participated in the Global Colloquium of Participant-centered Learning organized by Harvard Business School, USA.

faculty.name: Shibani Belwalkar
faculty.title: Leadership Coach & Visiting Faculty
faculty.description: An author and faculty member at NMIMS, Dr. Shibani is a behavioral coach and leading organizational culture transformation expert.

faqs.q: What are the entrance requirements for IMT Ghaziabad?
faqs.a: The eligibility requirements for different programs may differ. Candidates must have a bachelor's degree from a recognized university and may be required to fulfill other requirements such as work experience, admission exam results, and academic achievement.

faqs.q: Which admission tests are accepted by IMT Ghaziabad?
faqs.a: IMT Ghaziabad accepts CAT (Common Admission Test), XAT (Xavier Aptitude Test), GMAT (Graduate Management Admission Test), and CMAT (Common Management Admission Test) results.

faqs.q: Does IMT Ghaziabad offer financial aid or scholarships?
faqs.a: Yes, IMT Ghaziabad provides eligible students with financial aid through scholarships, loans, and EMI.

faqs.q: How do you rate the professors at IMT Ghaziabad?
faqs.a: The faculty at IMT Ghaziabad comprises seasoned academicians and industry specialists who bring a combination of theoretical knowledge and practical insights to the classroom.

faqs.q: How robust is IMT Ghaziabad's alum network?
faqs.a: The alum network of IMT Ghaziabad is large and prominent. Alums are actively involved with the institution by engaging in mentorship programs, giving industry insights, and assisting current students with placement chances.

faqs.q: What is it like to live on campus at IMT Ghaziabad?
faqs.a: IMT Ghaziabad has a thriving campus life with various extracurricular activities, clubs, sports facilities, and cultural events. The institute promotes comprehensive development and provides a welcoming atmosphere for students to pursue their passions.
